official.title: House Committees Investigate DoorDash’s Use of Chinese AI: A Recipe for Risk
official.body_facts: Moolenaar and Garbarino announced a letter to DoorDash CEO Tony Xu about national-security, cybersecurity and economic-security implications of adopting Chinese open-weight AI. The release says investigation began with Anysphere/Airbnb letters in April and DoorDash was a subsequent information request. It contains broad model-distillation/IP allegations; no HLE score, benchmark contamination, organizer ruling or Kimi model identity appears in the release body.
